story.iWant: calculate expected value (EV) for each AI probability + odds pair
story.soThat: I can identify picks with positive edge for threshold filtering
story.tasks: - Task 1: Review architecture and data contracts - Task 2: Create EV model structures - Task 3: Implement core EV calculation functions - Task 4: Implement market-specific EV calculation - Task 5: Implement batch EV calculation - Task 6: Implement EV filtering helper (for Story 5.2 dependency) - Task 7: Implement validation and error handling - Task 8: Create unit tests - Task 9: Create integration test with Story 4.4 - Task 10: Write module documentation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create `/src/bet_bot/analysis/edge/ev_calculator.py` module 2. Implement `def calculate_ev(ai_probability: float, odds: float) -> float` function with EV formula: `EV = (ai_prob × odds) - 1` 3. Implement `def calculate_implied_probability(odds: float) -> float` function: `implied_prob = 1 / odds` 4. Calculate EV for all available markets (match result, totals, corners, cards per data-dictionary.md) 5. Return EV in both decimal format (0.058) and percentage format (+5.8%) 6. Handle edge case: odds <= 1.0 (invalid, skip, log warning) 7. Handle edge case: AI prob outside [0.0, 1.0] (invalid, skip, log warning) 8. Handle edge case: NaN or None values (skip gracefully) 9. Create `EV` Pydantic model to structure calculation output 10. Implement batch processing function: `async def calculate_all_evs(fixtures: list[Fixture]) -> list[Fixture]` that attaches EV data to fixtures

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet:
Purpose: Calculate expected value, filter for picks. Modules: - ev_calculator.py - EV = (AI_prob × odds) - 1 - threshold_filter.py - Filter for EV > 5% - confidence_scorer.py - Assess data quality reliability
EV Calculation: ev = (ai_probability * odds) - 1

All available markets: - Match Result: match_result_home_win, match_result_draw, match_result_away_win (odds from API-Football) - Total Goals: total_goals_over_2_5, total_goals_under_2_5, total_goals_over_3_5, total_goals_under_3_5 - Corners: corners_over_9_5 (if available) - Cards: Various card markets (if available)

artifact.reason: Base model that will be extended with ev_results field; contains odds and ai_analysis data needed for EV calculation
Produces fixtures with ai_analysis populated; feeds data into EV calculator; error handling pattern for batch processing
Defines market analysis structure with probabilities; needed to understand how to extract probabilities from ai_analysis field
Understand existing error handling patterns; may need to add DataValidationError for EV validation

constraint.rule: All EV calculations must validate odds > 1.0 and ai_probability in [0.0, 1.0] before processing
Never raise exceptions from main functions; use graceful degradation with logging. Invalid values should set is_valid=False and skip_reason on EVResult model
Use module-level logger; log at DEBUG/INFO/WARNING levels. Progress: "Processing X of Y". Summary: counts and error list
Use async/await consistently with asyncio.gather for parallel operations; proper error handling with try/except per fixture
constraint.source: Story AC #5, #10 and CLAUDE.md async patterns

constraint.rule: Use Pydantic v2 syntax: field_validator, ConfigDict (not Config class), model_validator. All models must use populate_by_name=True for flexibility
All functions must have explicit return type annotations. Use modern syntax: list[X], dict[K,V], X | None (not Optional, List, Dict)
Batch processing may feed into Story 5.2 threshold filter; respect API rate limits from Story 4.2 (OpenAI already handles in batch_analyzer)
constraint.source: Story Dev Notes - sequential OpenAI analysis respects rate limits

interface.name: calculate_ev
interface.signature: def calculate_ev(ai_probability: float, odds: float) -> float | None
interface.description: Core EV calculation. Formula: (ai_probability * odds) - 1. Returns None if inputs invalid

interface.name: calculate_implied_probability
interface.description: Bookmaker implied probability from odds. Formula: 1.0 / odds. Returns None if odds <= 1.0

interface.name: calculate_all_evs
interface.description: Batch process fixtures. Attaches ev_results list to each fixture. Returns all fixtures (some may have error_message field)

interface.name: EVResult
interface.signature: class EVResult(BaseModel): market_type, outcome, ai_probability, odds, implied_probability, ev_decimal, ev_percentage, is_valid, skip_reason
interface.description: Structured output for single EV calculation. Used in list[EVResult] on Fixture

interface.name: Fixture.ai_analysis
interface.description: Input: AI probability estimates per market from batch_analyzer. Must be populated before calling calculate_all_evs()

interface.name: Fixture.odds
interface.description: Input: Bookmaker odds per market. Example: {"match_result": {"home": 2.10, "draw": 3.50, "away": 3.20}}

tests.standards: Unit tests: Pydantic model validation, EV formula accuracy (mathematical correctness), edge case handling (invalid odds, invalid probabilities, NaN/None). Integration tests: End-to-end with Story 4.4 fixture output, real MarketAnalysis data structure, multiple market types, batch processing pipeline. Framework: pytest. Coverage target: minimum 80% overall, 100% for critical paths (calculate_ev, calculate_implied_probability). Test locations: tests/unit/test_ev_calculator.py and tests/integration/test_ev_calculation_pipeline.py
tests.ideas:
Test calculate_ev() accuracy (AC #2): - Valid case: (0.58 × 2.10) - 1 = 0.058 (5.8% EV) ✓ - Valid case: (0.45 × 1.80) - 1 = -0.19 (negative EV, valid calculation) ✓ - Invalid: odds <= 1.0 → returns None ✓ - Invalid: ai_prob > 1.0 → returns None ✓ - Invalid: ai_prob < 0.0 → returns None ✓ - Edge: odds = 1.01, ai_prob = 0.99 → valid ✓
Test EVResult model (AC #9): - Valid EVResult creation with all fields ✓ - is_valid = True when odds > 1.0 and 0 <= ai_prob <= 1.0 ✓ - is_valid = False with skip_reason when validation fails ✓
Test calculate_all_evs() batch processing (AC #5, #10): - Empty fixture list → returns empty list ✓ - Single fixture with match_result market → produces 3 EVResult objects (home, draw, away) ✓ - Multiple fixtures with mixed success/failure → all processed, failures logged ✓ - Progress logging: "Processing X of Y" appears ✓ - Summary logging: total count and error count logged ✓
Test filter_evs_by_threshold() (AC for Story 5.2 prep): - Separates above/below 5% threshold correctly ✓ - Default threshold 5% ✓ - Custom threshold works ✓
Integration test with Story 4.4: - Load real fixture with ai_analysis field populated by batch_analyzer ✓ - Call calculate_all_evs() ✓ - Verify ev_results attached to fixture ✓ - Verify EV calculations mathematically correct against known values ✓ - Test multiple market types (match_result, total_goals, corners) ✓
